from src.lru import LRUCache

# Test 1: put/get
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put("a", 1)
assert c.get("a") == 1, "Test 1 failed"
print("Test 1 passed")

# Test 2: missing returns None
c = LRUCache(2)
result = c.get("zzz")
assert result is None, "Test 2 failed"
print("Test 2 passed")

# Test 3: evicts oldest without gets
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put("a", 1)
c.put("b", 2)
c.put("c", 3)
assert c.get("a") is None, "Test 3 failed"
assert c.get("c") == 3, "Test 3 failed"
print("Test 3 passed")

# Test 4: get refreshes recency
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put("a", 1)
c.put("b", 2)
c.get("a")
c.put("c", 3)
assert c.get("a") == 1, "Test 4 failed"
assert c.get("b") is None, "Test 4 failed"
print("Test 4 passed")

# Test 5: update existing key
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put("a", 1)
c.put("a", 9)
assert c.get("a") == 9, "Test 5 failed"
assert len(c) == 1, "Test 5 failed"
print("Test 5 passed")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
